gate_type: IMPLEMENTATION gate — Canonical TIPA Same-Session Production Semantics (R1)
objective: Make the selected canonical vNext TIPA RuntimeSession execute the already-accepted six-sub-line ASSY production semantics instead of advancing six empty clocks. Introduce the smallest immutable ASSY domain run profile/input seam (profile identity/version, scenario identity, effective per-sub-line scenario, deterministic exception target sub-line, pre-construction quality/config transforms, explicit initial SSO2/RSO2 inventory, deterministic carrier/feed sequencing, optional continuous feed settings, provenance marking the inputs as simulation/synthetic). Extract/reuse the smallest shared domain-run preparation helper so the canonical session path and the legacy accepted demo path cannot diverge. Canonical federation execution must reproduce the accepted production driver around AssyLineRuntime (replenish/prepare feed before a natural line step; on-demand RSO2 for AP04; execute_dwell(); index_line() only when READY_TO_INDEX; introduce the next SSO2 through the existing public runtime entry after index). Provide the smallest ASSY-domain hold/freeze seam to prove one-line-held/five-continue independence. R1 is runtime/domain-run semantics only: NO rich UI migration (R2), NO Observation/MES reintegration (R3), NO SH-WTP/gateway work. Full canonical regression + full suite green at the pushed head.
explicit_non_objectives: No R2 rich UI migration (Frame A/B, inspector, /assy-demo repointing)
No rewriten of AssyLineRuntime (no routing/conveyor/WIP/quality/genealogy/timing/AP/station/lifecycle internals changed)
No deletion of legacy demo paths
No consolidation of other legacy simulators
No promotion of demo/scenario policy to site truth
No silent rebase onto repository main
required_deliverables: src/virtual_factory/assembly/assy_run_profile.py (immutable ASSY run profile + shared pure preparation/feed/driver helpers)
src/virtual_factory/federation/assy_host.py (profile-driven deterministic construction/preparation; six isolated run states; profile-consistent reset)
src/virtual_factory/federation/assy_participant.py (production driver seam, state-driven; legacy structural step preserved when no run state)
src/virtual_factory/runcontrol/session.py (scenario_id -> pinned profile resolution in the TIPA session factory)
forbidden_actions: Reinterpret or redesign the R0 frozen recovery architecture
stop_conditions: Meaningful production requires changing accepted AssyLineRuntime domain semantics
Profile semantics cannot be extracted/reused without breaking accepted ASSY behavior
Scenario identity cannot be made effective without changing the G22 identity contract
One-line hold/freeze requires a new generic coordinator/synchronization policy
Replay/reset semantics conflict with the frozen G22 lifecycle
Implementation would make DemoController or another service a second active runtime authority
Accepted technical base cannot be reproduced from ed217c867dff048ee3774d139e53b8cfb1130251
Correct implementation requires touching outside the allowlist materially

Complete canonical baseline + full suite green at the pushed head
